name: cip-monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo for New Odyssey's Common Infrastructure Protocol.

scripts.build:ts: npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-control-plane-api && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-control-plane-worker && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-control-plane-migrate
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-control-plane-api && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-control-plane-worker
